summary: Focused verification completed. No relevant testing skill found. Code/build checks confirm /pay-partner-store and /partner-store/dashboard are outside the IS_USER_BUILD admin block and present in the user build static bundle. Web preview login succeeded; /pay-partner-store rendered pay-store-page with wallet balance + Step 1 lookup and partner store lookup worked. Native APK overlay behavior could not be physically exercised in this cloud preview, but the code path and user-build artifacts match the intended fix.

rca_of_the_issue: Prior APK blank page root cause was /pay-partner-store being declared inside the admin-only !IS_USER_BUILD block, so the user AAB stripped the route. The fix moves partner routes to top-level Routes and keeps a defensive PayPartnerStore loading fallback. Dashboard icon overlap was caused by per-page native banner lifecycle/zero-margin behavior; the fix centralizes native banner handling in GlobalBannerAd, hides it on Dashboard, and uses a 90dp bottom margin elsewhere.
